title: Mixed Event — An Ode for the Pure of Heart — Episode4 The Director's Orders

meta.Event: An Ode for the Pure of Heart
meta.Event Outline: Toya suddenly ends up taking on a role as a wedding flash mob extra. But when he arrives at the venue, unexpected circumstances mean that the director is nowhere to be seen. As the possibility of a canceled show grows greater by the second, Toya meets Rui...

rows.Line: Wedding Ceremony Hall - Waiting Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So I, Kamishiro, will be taking over as the director of this performance today...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to working with all of you. Let's make the most out of today's ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: I thought our bit got cancelled. Are we really doing this?

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: And that kid's gonna direct? He's young, but seems pretty calm. Can he really pull this off?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (A cloud of doubt still seems to be hanging over them. I suppose that should be expected...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, everyone, that's enough chatting for now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We only have two and a half hours until the ceremony starts. Whether we like it or not, the curtains will be going up at that time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How you perceive that moment, be it fearfully or eagerly, will all depend on what you decide to do right now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Whoa...
He just turned everything on its head...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So this is what a director can do...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, it's time we started rehearsing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Since we're limited on time, we'll still go with when the bride and groom say their vows, but I'll be making one small addition to that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
A small addition?
What do you have in mind?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, then here's a question for you.
What do you think is missing from the original idea?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What's missing...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm not sure...
Does it have to do with how the other guests should feel? Something about that felt a little strange to me...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I thought that man proposing to the bride so suddenly would only startle the other guests in reality...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Correct. Well done.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How the other guests feel that moment when he professes his love is the key...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What if there's some unrequited love that nobody else knows about there?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This was used in quite a few older movies, so I'm sure some of the guests will recognize what's going on.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, how will these guests react when they realize that this was all an act?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They'll say, “Oh, it was just an act,” and feel relieved...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. They'll finally be able to relax and laughter will begin to fill the room.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But some will definitely feel like they've been deceived and will have no interest what comes next. My addition will attempt to counteract those sentiments.

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: So spill it already. What do you plan on doing for that part?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I shall.
For that part...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll increase the men objecting to this wedding from one to three.

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why three?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's think about that for a second. How would you feel if that many objected to the wedding at once?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? Um...

rows.Speaker: Female Extra
rows.Line: It'll make the bride look really popular, I guess...?

rows.Speaker: Male Extra
rows.Line: No, it'll feel like some kind of weird surprise! Right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You're both correct.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By increasing the objectors to three, it'll draw more attention to the bride.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sure you've all seen something like this before in a fairy tale.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At the same time, having three men instead of one object at once will tell the guests that this is staged and not real.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In other words, they'll immediately realize that this is a show or a prank of sorts.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I see...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The original scenario would've only served to startle or worry the other guests. It may've even led to further trouble...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (By having so many people object at the same time, it'll ease any tension, give everyone an opportunity to realize what's going on and let them laugh a little.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So let us decide who will have the honor of proposing to the bride right now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Gentlemen, I'd like to know about any talents you may possess, if you will...

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line:
Talents?
For me, that's dancing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay, dancing.
How about you?

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: I used to play basketball, so I know how to dribble pretty well.

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: They're not great or anything, but I like drawing caricatures of people...

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: I'm good at origami.

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: I can...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
Last but not least, how about you, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm good at...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (To most people, that would be playing the piano or the violin...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But that's in the past now. The thing I want to say right now is...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Singing...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
I believe we're all set then.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll have our resident basketball player, origami artist and singer be the ones who propose to the bride! Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: What?! Why'd you choose them...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You'll find out why during the wedding.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're actors now with proper roles to fill.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Time to break a leg, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right.
I'll do my best, Kamishiro.
